preconditions.description: The number of employees n is between 1 and 500,000 inclusive.
The number of teams k is between 1 and 8,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(team_counts) == k and all(1 <= c <= n for c in team_counts)
preconditions.description: There are exactly k teams, each having at least one employee, and the sum of all team sizes equals n.

postconditions.expression: min_cost == min((s * ((sum(team_counts) + s - 1) // s)) for s in range(1, n + 1) if all(c <= s for c in team_counts) and all((c1 + c2) <= s for c1 in team_counts for c2 in team_counts if c1 != c2 or (c1 == c2 and team_counts.count(c1) > 1)))
postconditions.description: The output is the minimum cost s * r, where s is the bus capacity and r is the number of rides required to transport all employees such that each ride carries either one or two entire teams, and no team is split.
The output is a positive integer representing the minimum cost.
